messages.subject: Re: normalized count to Deseq2
messages.body_plain:
This mailing list is reserved for teaching related discussions, not
for general questions. Please use the support site for that
https://support.bioconductor.org/.

But I can already confirm that you should never use normalised counts
as input for DESeq2.

Best wishes,

Laurent
